page.layout: Running head at top; two italic paragraphs at full width; below them two columns of names, left column then right column, separated by a vertical rule and horizontal rules between years; signature and catchword at the foot right; page number at top right.

p.i: Hi omnes accepti & expensi rationes reddiderunt soli civi-tati Groningane: & civitas sola fructus Camerae percepit, & in suum usum vertit, ut ex vetustis Rationum indicibus, qui in publicis libris servantur, licet intelligere.
Post hos qui secuti sunt per annos xix. partim sub Edsardo, partim sub Carolo Geldro, eorum nomina interciderunt, aut saltem à me reperiri non potuerunt.

page.notes: Two columns, read left then right. Horizontal rules separate the years 1526 and 1528 in the left column and are not text. The left-column governor headings are set in capitals and centred. Catchword "Reinet" is partly worn and uncertain. Signature "Y 4" is at the foot right. Some lines in the right column near the edge are faint from show-through and were read from the clearer printed letters.
